completion_promises.criterion_text: Boot tests are hermetic (env pinned via monkeypatch)
completion_promises.evidence: All TASK-KCA2-004 boot tests implement hermetic environment isolation using subprocess.Popen with explicit env dictionary construction (turn 1). Each test uses os.environ.copy() followed by targeted modifications to pin specific environment variables required for the test scenario, then passes this hermetic env dict to subprocess via env parameter. This prevents cross-test contamination and ensures complete environment isolation. Tests set auth-mode-specific variables (STUDY_TUTOR_AUTH_MODE, STUDY_TUTOR_OIDC_ISSUER, STUDY_TUTOR_OIDC_AUDIENCE) and required baseline variables (STUDY_TUTOR_PG_DSN, STUDY_TUTOR_HTTP_TOKENS) explicitly in the hermetic env. All six AC tests demonstrate this hermetic pattern.
